about: The look's shot list (Session 2675): eight fixed views of seed 1, each paired with the P10b panel (OG-147) it answers. scripts/look_shots.mjs renders them at High and lays each beside its panel. A view is an anchor (a site id, a peak's name, a gate's name, or the coast found walking from a site), the camera's offset from it in metres (dx east, dz south, up over the ground under the camera, or over the water where the sea covers it: Session 2689) and the point looked at (offset from the anchor, up over the ground there). panel is the crop of docs/art/thumbs/OG-147.jpg (480 x 320) as [x, y, w, h]. Change a view only with a note in the devlog: the sheets are compared across sessions.

views.title: A Mark upland, 13h
views.note: Session 2748 (Michael's A on #2120): the camera moved from dx 0, dz 950 (inside a snow-pine stand since S2720, the fell hidden by trunks) to the stand's northern edge, in a clearing with no tree in the 70 m before it (nor scrub in 25), the stand at its back and the moor open to the fell. The same session keyed the scatter's regions by place (withPlace): before, the trees at this spot changed with the views rendered before it.

views.title: A lesser gate's court, dusk (18h30)
views.note: Session 2697 (the critic, 26 Nov): the gate is named, ring gate seed 137, found from a fixed point near the start, and the cells at the camera are loaded and their jobs run before the frame. It was the gate nearest wherever the last view left px, its near level never built (a black hump after the storm view). The baseline of 25 Nov happened to show this gate.
